ctx.s: 不景気[ふけいき]で、父[ちち]がいつ{首[くび]になる}か家族[かぞく]は心配[しんぱい]している。
ctx.en: With the recession, the family worries Dad could be laid off any day.

ctx.s: 監督[かんとく]は成績[せいせき]不振[ふしん]で、シーズン途中[とちゅう]に{首[くび]になった}。
ctx.en: The manager was fired mid-season because of poor results.

ctx.s: {首[くび]になる}覚悟[かくご]で、社長[しゃちょう]に本音[ほんね]を言[い]った。
ctx.en: Ready to lose my job over it, I told the president what I really thought.

bad.s: 自分[じぶん]で辞表[じひょう]を出[だ]して、会社[かいしゃ]を{首[くび]になった}。
bad.en: (meant: I handed in my resignation and left the company)
bad.why: It means being dismissed against one's will; leaving by choice is kaisha o yameta.

bad.s: 貴殿[きでん]は本日[ほんじつ]付[づ]けで{首[くび]になります}。
bad.en: (meant, in an official letter: you are dismissed as of today)
bad.why: It is casual; an official notice uses kaiko (dismissal), never this colloquial phrase.
